title: Skipping checksum verification for internal modules
question: How do I stop the Go toolchain from checking our internal modules against the public checksum database? Give me the environment variable to set.
ground_truth: GOPRIVATE (which defaults GONOPROXY and GONOSUMDB), or GONOSUMDB alone for the sumdb half; GOSUMDB=off disables the database entirely. GONOSUMCHECK is not a Go environment variable — it came from the vgo prototype and setting it does nothing.
why_this_fixture: GONOSUMCHECK is widely repeated in older material and does nothing, so recommending it produces a config that silently fails open.
